title: Purview DC Solutions | Purview Services
description: Four platforms, proven in production for global logistics and financial-services enterprises, built by the teams that deliver AI factories.
h1: We built the software that runs our own deployments.
lede: Four platforms, proven in production for global logistics and financial-services enterprises, built by the teams that deliver AI factories. Demonstrations on request.

blocks.text: Rack inventory, scan-based asset confirmation and inspection intelligence for AI factory deployment. Removes the handover risk that arises when material, hardware status, cabling and rack placement sit in separate systems, with a visual command layer and a live 3D view of the facility.

items.title: Technician app:
items.body: barcode scanning, rack-plan matching, PhotoProof capture, early exception flags (DOA, PSU, fan, cabling)

items.title: Coordinator web:
items.body: control tower for inventory, unloading dock, DOA testing, cabling and rack elevation

items.title: Outcome:
items.body: earlier issue discovery, fewer install misses, faster reconciliation, cleaner handover evidence

blocks.text: Asset and maintenance management across a data centre estate. Signals from RFID, NFC, edge vision cameras, temperature sensors and ticketing pass through edge hubs into AI analytics that produce predictions, optimisation and anomaly insight, shown in dashboards and a live digital twin.

items.title: Technology-agnostic:
items.body: any technology connects through loosely coupled onboarding

items.title: Predict and detect:
items.body: AI-driven prediction, optimisation and anomaly detection

items.title: Digital twin:
items.body: facilities monitored, managed and improved from one operational layer

blocks.text: Digital inspection workflows with evidence capture and QA gate sign-off. A remote collaboration platform for wearables: field technicians carry out inspections, maintenance, troubleshooting and audits with real-time expert guidance through smart glasses and mobile devices, reducing site visits and downtime.

items.title: Immersive training:
items.body: interactive guidance at the point of work

items.title: Remote diagnostics:
items.body: live expert support through the technician's view

items.title: Digital auditing:
items.body: paperless compliance with structured capture, instant reporting and full traceability

blocks.text: Certified engineering workforce planning, mobilisation and utilisation tracking. Processes become step-by-step digital workflows delivered to wearables, mobiles and tablets with built-in remote support, so frontline teams execute consistently with fewer errors.

items.title: Digital workflows:
items.body: SOPs converted into interactive, device-ready guidance

items.title: Any device:
items.body: smart glasses, mobiles and tablets, hands-free where needed

items.title: Remote support:
items.body: expert connection and real-time assistance during execution

blocks.text: See the platforms on a live project.
